description: The life and income cover a household would need if one earner died or couldn't work, against what it has: debts cleared and take-home pay replaced for a number of years, minus life cover, death in service and savings; and the monthly bills that pay covers, minus sick pay and income protection, with how many months savings would cover any gap. Use for 'do I have enough life insurance?' or 'would we manage if I couldn't work?'.

billsMonthly.description: Essential bills and debt payments a month, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

deathInService.description: A lump sum from work if they die in service, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

incomeProtectionMonthly.description: What an income protection policy pays a month, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

lifeCover.description: What their life insurance pays out, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

mortgage.description: Their share of any mortgages, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

otherDebts.description: Cards, loans and other personal debts, in pounds - not a student loan, which is written off on a death. Defaults to 0.

otherIncomeMonthly.description: Other pay that would keep coming in, such as a partner's take-home, a month, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

savings.description: Cash and investments the household could reach, not pensions or the home, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

sickPayMonthly.description: Sick pay from work a month, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

takeHomeMonthly.description: Their take-home pay a month, in pounds.

yearsOfPay.description: Years of that pay to replace. Defaults to 10.

name: calculate_protection_check
title: Protection check
